name: smwsprites-yi-nipper-and-dandelion
title: YI Nipper and Dandelion
description:
Yoshi's island Dandelion parachute, spawns a sprite after touching the ground.

the palette and the sprite it spawns can also be customized with the extra bytes.

also comes with the YI nipper plant and a cluster sprite for the smoke.

check the ASM file for details on how to use the sprite

requested by Rykon-V73

2022-05-25:
added a option to decrease the amount of cluster smoke that the dandelion spawns

converted some ram addresses I missed, the sprites should properly work on sa-1 now.

added a delay for the nippers (this can be toggled off in the ASM file)
